PaymentAlert.title: PaymentAlert
PaymentAlert.description: A merchant payment notification captured by PaySpeaker and announced via Text-to-Speech.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the merchant who owns this payment alert.

senderName.description: Optional name of the payer if extracted from notification.

sourceLabel.description: Display label of the payment source (e.g., eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay).

packageName.description: Android package name that posted the payment notification.

spokenText.description: Announcement sentence generated for TTS playback.

spoken.description: Whether the soundbox spoke the alert aloud.

simulated.description: Whether this alert was generated via Quick Soundbox Test simulation.

clientTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the notification was received.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MerchantSettings.title: MerchantSettings
MerchantSettings.description: Cloud-synced merchant soundbox voice and channel preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the merchant.

merchantName.description: Shop or merchant name announced during payment alerts.

boostVolume.description: Whether to raise media volume during announcements.

playChime.description: Whether to play a chime before announcements.

announceSender.description: Whether to announce sender name aloud.

announceSource.description: Whether to announce payment app name aloud.

enabledChannels.description: List of enabled PaymentChannel enum names.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/payment_alerts/{alertId}.description: Per-user payment notification ledger synced to Cloud Firestore.

/users/{userId}/merchant_settings/{setti.description: Per-user synced merchant soundbox voice and channel configuration.
